1P1D Gemma4 26B NVFP4 bring-up FAILED on WSL2 - P2pNcclConnector cannot initialize cross-container NCCL. Prefill (GPU 0, gpu_mem_util 0.80) and decode (GPU 1, 0.80) both load successfully and report healthy at :8100/:8101; proxy at :8200 routes OK. On first real request, prefill calls ncclCommInitRank(2,unique_id,rank=0) and decode listener calls ncclCommInitRank(2,unique_id,rank=1) simultaneously; both fail with RuntimeError: NCCL error: unhandled cuda error at pynccl_wrapper.py:416. Root cause: WSL2 does not support CUDA IPC (cudaIpcGetMemHandle) required by NCCL for cross-process GPU-to-GPU data transfer (NVIDIA WSL user guide - features-not-yet-supported). Fixes applied during bring-up: (a) gpu_mem_util 0.90/0.85->0.80/0.80 to avoid OOM killer from prior attempt, (b) added CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0/1 envs since docker --gpus device=N does not isolate in WSL2 (both containers saw both GPUs; prefill and decode were both on GPU 0), (c) added VLLM_HOST_IP=127.0.0.1 so ZMQ binds loopback matching proxy request_id KV_IP. Recommendation: KILL ASI-1 on WSL2 hardware. Disaggregated 1P1D requires bare-metal Linux OR a different KV connector not dependent on CUDA IPC (e.g. LMCacheConnector with shared storage, or NIXL/UCX). For this node, stay on serve_gemma4_dp2.sh (T1-G DP=2 baseline is 2965 tok/s FP8 KV, projected 24k peak).
